title: Quarry
subtitle: MV, 8000 FE a block
text:
The Quarry runs on MV only (Gold Cable, an LV/MV transformer front or a Diamond Solar Panel); LV will not feed it and HV blows it up. Each block costs 8000 FE: 400 FE/t at 1 block/s. It stores 200k FE, 400k on steel. It digs the area beside it to bedrock, 16x16 or up to 64 blocks set by Landmarks in line with its front and to a side.

Speed: 1 block/s, x1.5 steel, x1.25 steel drill body, plus drill and chassis upgrades sharing one +100% cap. A diamond bit digs obsidian. Up to 3 Pipe Filters pick what it keeps: deny filters always void, and with any allow filter fitted only what one allows is kept.

The frame is free and goes up piece by piece once the quarry has power. If a piece is broken the quarry stops and rebuilds it piece by piece, then carries on. Blocks in the frame's way are dug out first; if one can't be, it waits. Blocks dropped into the pit get dug too.
